"vertical_alignment": "middle"}, "value": "目前 Wellness 1 再营销项目正在进行 PR Strategy Development 阶段。基于竞品分析及市场洞察，我们重新梳理了 Wellness 1 的核心传播方向：从单一产品功能竞争，升级为 Momcozy 母婴品牌价值竞争。\n通过与 eufy 等竞品对比发现，单纯强调加热、按摩等产品功能，容易陷入同质化竞争。因此，Wellness 1 后续传播将弱化单一功能卖点，重点强化 Momcozy 作为母婴专业品牌在母乳喂养支持、产前产后陪伴以及专业资源体系上的差异化优势。\nJuly Progress & Current Plan\n1. Earned Media Re-pitch Strategy Development\n7月主要进行 Earned Media 再营销方案整理，针对下半年关键媒体节点制定 pitch 方向，包括：\n  Fall Product Discovery（秋季新品/产品发现机会）   重新激活媒体关注 Wellness 1 \n  结合秋季新品推荐、健康生活方式、妈妈生活场景等内容方向进行媒体 outreach \nHoliday Shopping Season Preparation   提前布局 Black Friday / Cyber Monday 购物季媒体机会 争取进入 Gift Guide、Holiday Shopping Guide、Best Products List 等年底重点内容 Year-end Awards & Recommendation Lists   针对年底 Best Breast Pump、Best Baby Products、Mom Essentials 等榜单进行长期渗透 提前建立媒体认知，提高入选机会 \n2. Brand Positioning & Messaging Refinement\n基于竞品分析，我们调整 Wellness 1 的 PR Narrative：\nPrevious Product-focused Narrative：\n强调加热、按摩、舒适体验等单一产品功能。\nUpdated Brand-led Narrative：\n从 Momcozy 品牌定位出发，强调：\n Momcozy is more than a breast pump brand. We support moms throughout their breastfeeding journey with products, education, and professional lactation support.\n核心传播方向：\nProfessional Breastfeeding Support Ecosystem\n包括：\n  产品支持： \n  Wellness 1 \n  Momcozy Breast Pump Portfolio \n  专业支持： \n  IBCLC（International Board Certified Lactation Consultant）专业支持 \n  母乳喂养知识教育 \n  产前准备及产后恢复支持 \n  品牌价值： \n  从“卖一个吸奶器” \n  转变为“陪伴妈妈完成整个母乳喂养旅程”"}, "乳腺炎是一个高痛点、高搜索量、高咨询需求的话题，在美国哺乳期患病概率是7%–10%，属于常见并发症，通常可治愈，但对妈妈的疼痛、情绪和持续母乳喂养的影响很大，是提前停止母乳喂养的重要原因之一。\n乳腺炎通常不是突然发生的，而是一个逐步发展的过程：涨奶未及时缓解，可能导致乳汁淤积；持续的乳汁淤积会增加堵奶和乳腺炎的风险。\n涨奶（Engorgement） → 淤积（Milk stasis）→  堵奶（Plugged）→  乳腺炎（Mastitis） \n\n加热按摩吸奶器并不是用于治疗涨奶、堵奶或乳腺炎的医疗设备。当妈妈已经出现明显炎症症状（如持续红肿、剧烈疼痛、发热等）时，应及时咨询医生或哺乳专业人士。\n它真正的价值在于作用于问题发生的前端——帮助更容易出现乳房胀满或乳汁淤积风险的妈妈（如奶量较大、无法规律吸奶或需要高频吸奶的人群），获得更舒适、更顺畅、更充分的排奶体验，从而帮助维持良好的乳汁排出和泌乳管理。\nW1 doesn't "不能笼统宣称W1可以解决或缓解疼痛，因为疼痛的来源不同。\nW1强调的是舒适度，而不是治疗疼痛，能够帮助缓解乳房胀满带来的不适。\n疼痛是一种症状，可能由法兰尺寸不合适、乳头没有对中、吸力过高、泵奶过久、乳头损伤、血管痉挛、涨奶或乳腺炎等不同原因引起。\nW1的全乳面温热、五区吸力同步按摩、SoftPulse吸力和DoubleFit™法兰“旨在让泵奶感觉更温和、更舒适”。"}, It’s comfortable to wear, fits into any size bra, and is even slightly more subtle looking than other wearables I’ve tried. It has a great battery life and settings are easily controlled through the easy to use app. The warming feature makes milk flow better and makes pumping more comfortable in general. I’ve had similar output with this pump compared to my “hospital grade” or wall plug in pump. There aren’t too many parts and pieces, making cleaning a breeze. The milk capacity is enough for me, but it does have a sensor that lets you know when the cups are becoming full. Multiple flange sizes and a measuring tool are included. Overall this is a great pump with some really cool features that makes pumping on the go an easy experience."}, {"cell_styles": {"font_size": 13, "vertical_alignment": "middle"}, "value": "I absolutely love this pump, i highly recommend! I went from getting 1-2 let downs per 30 minute pump session to now getting at least 5-6 let downs per session! My 5m old eats 6 ounces bottles every 3 hours and i am now able to pump enough for him to be able to have that!\nAbout the pump it’s self: The pump is a little bigger then the air 1 but its not huge! I have bigger tatas and its a lot more discreet then other pumps! It’s also super comfortable to wear! I have paruu p16s before this pump and i hated pumping because they were so uncomfortable and now love pumping again as i am an exclusively pumping mama! Thank you mom cozy for creating this pump! You guys are amazing!"}, {"cell_styles": {"font_size": 13, "vertical_alignment": "middle"}, "value": "10/10 WORTH IT - Read below.\nHonestly im not really big on reviewing items. But I had to for this pump. First and foremost, cleaning this has been the easiest. It has 12 different levels and honest to God, the warming and massaging effect feels like heaven. I’ve tried so many others that I swore off wearables and stuck to strictly using manual pumps. But being that im going back to work next week I figured what the heck lemme try one more. The features of warm and massaging drew me in. And yes the price is a bit hefty, but it’s so high tech and super worth it. as a first time mom this has definitely left me extremely happy. I usually have issues with suction because unfortunately I do have elastic nips, but these felt so buttery smooth and painless!! Compared to the M5 I will choose this any day. the m5 gives me an output of 3-4oz and Lowers to 2oz throughout the day. I get super irritated nips and it leaves me upset because I usually pump 5-8oz after my morning pump, with the lowest being 4oz at the end of the night. But my first try with these Wellness 1 pumps (this was my third pump of the day) gave me a good 6.5oz in 24 minutes. It’s so easy to use and the comfort lets me have peace of mind to do whatever I need to around the house. Especially without worrying about spilling since it has a stopper at the top. The noise level I will say, can be quieter— but it’s to be expected with electric pumps. If you’re on the fence like I was— I say make the purchase. I was so excited about this pump but it’s been such a disappointment. I’ve used it 3-4 times and I’m not getting nearly as much output as I usually do. Even with my m5 I could fill the cup. With these pumps I’m not getting more than 3 oz per side. So to test it I pumped with the wellness 1 and got about 2oz per side until nothing was coming out. Then I pumped for just 10 minutes immediately after with my spectra and got another 5oz total. Also the “massage” is a vibration and I absolutely hate it. I’m only giving this 2 stars because I like the heating element."}, {"cell_styles": {"font_size": 13, "vertical_alignment": "middle"}, "value": "After searching through multiple stores my husband got me this set. I started crying in joy when I was able to make a bottle to leave the house for once. They finally gave me hope that I can rebuild my storage supply and feed my baby while im out of the house instead of covering my windows to breast feed in the car for an hour."}, {"cell_styles": {"font_size": 13, "vertical_alignment": "middle"}, "value": "I love the warming feature and that there is a lot of different combinations of setting to be used. In addition to the warming function, it also includes a massage feature, which was something I had not seen before. I have used pumps with warming technology in the past and never noticed a significant difference in my output, but I was definitely curious to see how the massage function would perform.\n\n\n\nOne of the features I really like is the dedicated app. It makes adjusting settings simple and gives you a lot of control over your pumping sessions. There are four different suction modes and twelve levels of suction, allowing you to customize the experience to what works best for you.\n\n\n\nEach collection cup holds up to 6 ounces of milk, which is more than enough for me since I tend to be more of a just enough or slight under supplier. The cups fit comfortably in my bra and are actually lower profile than my Eufy S1 pumps, which was a pleasant surprise. As with any wearable pump, having a good pumping bra makes a huge difference in both comfort and performance.\n\n\n\nI am able to move around easily while wearing these and could comfortably wear them in public if needed. The motors are also fairly quiet. In normal everyday environments, I do not think most people would even notice them running.\n\n\n\nThe massage feature is interesting, although I am still undecided on whether it is improving my output. I do have a larger chest, so I am not sure if that affects how noticeable the massage function is.\n\n\n\nBattery life has been very good so far. I typically charge them overnight, and they are ready to go all day. I have been alternating between these and my Spectra. While I still get slightly more output with my Spectra, that could simply be because I am still experimenting with the settings and finding what works best for my body.\n\n\n\nCleaning is also straightforward. The pump comes apart easily, which is a huge plus when you are washing parts late at night and preparing everything for the next day.\n\n\n\nOverall, I am very happy with this wearable pump. It offers a lot of useful features, is comfortable to wear, and performs well. One of the things I dislike most about pumping is how much time it consumes. Sitting down every few hours and being tied to a traditional pump for 15 to 20 minutes at a time can really add up. The biggest advantage of this wearable pump is the freedom it provides. Being able to move around, take care of household tasks, and continue with daily life while pumping has been a huge improvement.\n\n\n\nThat said, I would not describe it as particularly discreet. It is fairly obvious that there is something being worn under a shirt, and it noticeably increases the appearance of cup size. It also produces enough noise that people nearby can hear it running. Because of that, I tend to use it primarily around immediate family rather than in public settings.\n\n\n\nIn terms of performance, I have been pleasantly surprised. Coming from a Spectra pump, I was concerned that a wearable model might not provide enough suction or be as effective at milk removal. Fortunately, that has not been my experience. The suction is stronger than I expected, and I have not needed to use the highest settings to get good results.\n\n\n\nMy favorite feature is easily the heating function. The added warmth helps me achieve letdown more comfortably and has made pumping a more pleasant experience overall. The massage feature, on the other hand, does not do much for me personally, so I generally leave it turned off.\n\n\n\nBattery life has also been sufficient for my needs and has not been a source of frustration.\n\n\n\nThe biggest drawback is cleaning. There are a lot of individual parts that must be disassembled, washed, and reassembled. I understand that wearable pumps are more complex than traditional setups, but the number of pieces makes cleanup more time consuming than I would like.\n\n\n\nOverall, this pump does exactly what I hoped it would do: it allows me to pump while continuing to get things done around the house. As a busy mom trying to balance feeding, household responsibilities, and work, this pump has made my breastfeeding journey so much easier and more comfortable.\n\nThe standout feature for me is the heated flange with simulated massage technology. The gentle warmth combined with the massage function helps encourage let-down naturally and makes pumping feel much more comfortable compared to traditional pumps. My biggest pet peeve is always being \"stuck\" to the outlet because my go to pump has always been a Medela double electric. I did try a wearable pump at one point, but it was a no name and fell short of my expectations. My biggest complaint of that pump was leaking, not something anyone wants. Not only does leaking get milk all over your clothes etc but then your hard work was for nothing. I've tried it all, from haaka silicone, to manual hand pumps, and multiple double electric pumps.\n\n\n\nThis is by far the fanciest pump I have ever owned. This is way nicer than my other wearable one, and the design is far better at preventing leaking or spilled milk. The added bonus of heat and massage can streamline pumping sessions since letdown is easier. The wearable design means I'm not stuck, though I still prefer to cozy up and relax with a drink and snack when pumping. I so wish I had this when I was exclusively pumping, it would have been a game changer. I'm still breastfeeding currently, but I don't pump as often now that my baby can empty me effectively. I am someone who deals with significant oversupply in the early months of lactation, so the 6oz capacity is a bit small for my needs. It's not too much trouble to pause and pour into a container mid pump, but this is something to keep in mind if you are pumping large volumes at a time. I've pumped over 20oz in one sitting before, obviously that's not an issue for your average breastfeeding mom and the combined 12oz capacity is more than enough for most.\n\n\n\nThe app to go along with this breast pump is actually pretty neat, it can sync with all of the Momcozy devices and track a lot of different data if you'd like. The pump works fine without the app too, if that's your preference, but I like that it functions as a remote for the pump settings. The connection is Bluetooth and is very easy to figure out, even for someone who's not tech savvy. The battery life is impressive and lasts for several sessions without needing charged. I do wish this came with a case.\n\n\n\nI think aside from the milk capacity the only other con for me on this pump is price, it's definitely expensive. If you're only pumping occasionally it may not be worth the cost. However... If you're pumping daily, I personally feel it's worth it to have the added heat, massage, and hands free cordless features. I am impressed with this device overall."}, {"cell_styles": {"font_size": 13, "vertical_alignment": "middle"}, "value": "A lot of pieces to clean. As a pumping parent, convenience matters, especially when you're washing pump parts multiple times a day like I seem to be somedays. The design is straightforward, and I didn’t have to struggle with figuring out how the pieces fit together after cleaning thanks to the guide.\n\nThe battery life has also been excellent. I can get through multiple pumping sessions before needing to recharge, which makes it much more convenient when I'm away from home or don't want to be tied to an outlet. Having reliable battery performance gives me one less thing to worry about during busy days. The included charger is able to charge both pumps at the same time which helps cut down on the amount of USB bricks I need to use.\n\nIn terms of milk output, I'm getting results that are comparable to what I get with my Spectra S1 and off brand hands free pump however please keep in mind everyone responds differently and correct flange size is important. The overall build quality feels nice, and the pump is comfortable to wear and use although it is a bit bulky(most likely due to the design having heat and massage).\n\nThe main area that needs improvement I feel is the app/additional features. While it's helpful to have app connectivity which I love, I was disappointed that there is no way to monitor or track the amount of breast milk collected during a session. Another feature that's missing is an overflow notification. Since the app doesn't alert you when the collection cups are nearing capacity(if you are like me and get a larger volume during your middle of the night pump, you still need to manually check milk levels throughout your pumping session. Those app shortcomings don't take away from the pump's actual performance, which has been excellent.\n\nOverall, I'm very pleased with this pump. "embed-image"}]}, {"cell_styles": {"font_size": 13, "vertical_alignment": "middle"}, "rich_text": [{"style": {"font_size": 13}, "text": "Comparing the Momcozy Air 1’s and Wellness 1’s after 7 weeks of relactating\nThe top pics are the Momcozy Air 1’s and the bottom pics are the Momcozy Wellness 1’s. Overall I love both of them (especially since they both come with a milk boosting program and stand on their own), but there are some key differences!\n\nPro’s of the Air 1’s:\n- They’re so slim\n- The charging case is very convenient\n- They sense & measure your milk output\n- They have an overflow feature\n\nCon’s of the Air 1’s:\n- No heating or vibration\n- No way to actually read what suction level you’re on without the app\n- Disconnecting the milk collector from the motor can be hard at times\n\n", "type": "text"}, {"style": {"font_color": "#f54a45", "font_size": 13, "font_weight": "bold"}, "text": "Pro’s of the Wellness 1’s:\n- Quicker letdowns thanks to the heating & vibration features\n- They’re extremely comfortable\n- I get better milk output in less time with these than I do with the Air 1’s\n\nCon’s of the Wellness 1’s:\n- No overflow alerts\n- No charging case\n- Slightly bulkier than the Air 1’s", "type": "text"}], "value": "Comparing the Momcozy Air 1’s and Wellness 1’s after 7 weeks of relactating\nThe top pics are the Momcozy Air 1’s and the bottom pics are the Momcozy Wellness 1’s. Overall I love both of them (especially since they both come with a milk boosting program and stand on their own), but there are some key differences!\n\nPro’s of the Air 1’s:\n- They’re so slim\n- The charging case is very convenient\n- They sense & measure your milk output\n- They have an overflow feature\n\nCon’s of the Air 1’s:\n- No heating or vibration\n- No way to actually read what suction level you’re on without the app\n- Disconnecting the milk collector from the motor can be hard at times\n\nPro’s of the Wellness 1’s:\n- Quicker letdowns thanks to the heating & vibration features\n- They’re extremely comfortable\n- I get better milk output in less time with these than I do with the Air 1’s\n\nCon’s of the Wellness 1’s:\n- No overflow alerts\n- No charging case\n- Slightly bulkier than the Air 1’s"}, {"cell_styles": {"font_size": 13, "vertical_alignment": "middle"}, "value": "FB 社群"}, {"cell_styles": {"font_size": 13, "vertical_alignment": "middle"}, "vertical_alignment": "middle"}, "value": "#MyCozyFeedingSupport\nI got the Wellness 1 pump when my other pump died at work. It has been such a godsend on my way to and back home from work. My drive is about an hour and a half both ways so I pump for an hour in the morning and half an hour driving home. Aside from that I pump 2-3 more times on my shift. I know I can get through an entire workday on one charge which is amazing. During my shifts I felt I was constantly trying to adjust my pumps in my Gap nursing bra. So I went and bought a couple Momcozy nursing bras and it changed how stressed I was pumping at work. There was definitely more coverage which completely held the pumps in and I didn’t have to worry about losing one when I was bending down to empty a catheter or when I was helping a mom breastfeed. Being able to throw my wearables on and not stress about them while I’m working is so nice esp when I have a million other things to stress at work. The Wellness 1 and the Momcozy nursing bras are the combo to go with."}, {"cell_styles": {"font_size": 13, "vertical_alignment": "middle"}, "value": "FB 社群"}, {"cell_styles": {"font_size": 13, {"cell_styles": {"font_size": 13, "vertical_alignment": "middle"}, "rich_text": [{"style": {"font_size": 13}, "text": "A ROUTINE THAT GREW WITH ME \n\nI don’t think I realized how much my pumping routine would change until I was actually in it.\n\nWith three babies, pumping became such a huge part of my day. In the beginning I was just focused on getting through each session and making sure I had enough milk for my girls. There wasn’t much time to think about making things easier. I was just doing what needed to be done.\n\nMy Momcozy pump eventually became one of those things tha", "type": "text"}, {"style": {"font_color": "#f54a45", "font_size": 13, "font_weight": "bold"}, "text": "t helped me find a little more freedom in my routine.", "type": "text"}, {"style": {"font_size": 13}, "text": " I didn’t always have to stop everything and sit down in one place to pump. That may sound like a small thing, but when you have three little ones depending on you, those little things matter.\n\nI also had to learn that finding the right routine takes some experimenting. I had to figure out which settings felt best, when I got the most comfortable sessions and how to work pumping around everything else going on. I definitely didn’t get it right the first time.\n\nSome days my routine still gets completely thrown off.  That’s motherhood.\n\nBut I think that’s the biggest thing I’ve learned. Your routine doesn’t have to look perfect to be a good routine. Sometimes you just keep making little changes until you find something that works better for your life.\n\nFor me, the goal has never been to have the perfect pumping schedule. It’s been finding ways to make pumping feel a little more manageable while still being present for my babies.\n\nAnd honestly, anything that gives me a little more freedom during the day is a win in my book. \n\n", "type": "text"}, {"link": "https://www.facebook.com/hashtag/mycozyfeedingsupport?__cft__[0]=AZjhCcsLb1x66WgXBozGI4Lf2os_vdCYQA_q30wpgpehBt3OdwjbgwyLhj02a4SU_o7PP5sA3Z0qtkmffv9Cag7vzN3tte4fdHqmJgPonpl4MNrrH-DxK_rr0tRVasXWjMjKk7kn5BLF63OoabLd-oIlMkTbLi6KiYTA_dPbXDt7wZfDyaq8us051q_IB8gG&__tn__=*NK*F", "text": "#MyCozyFeedingSupport", "type": "link"}, {"style": {"font_size": 13}, "text": " ", "type": "text"}], "value": "A ROUTINE THAT GREW WITH ME \n\nI don’t think I realized how much my pumping routine would change until I was actually in it.\n\nWith three babies, pumping became such a huge part of my day. In the beginning I was just focused on getting through each session and making sure I had enough milk for my girls. There wasn’t much time to think about making things easier. I was just doing what needed to be done.\n\nMy Momcozy pump eventually became one of those things that helped me find a little more freedom in my routine. I didn’t always have to stop everything and sit down in one place to pump. That may sound like a small thing, but when you have three little ones depending on you, those little things matter.\n\nI also had to learn that finding the right routine takes some experimenting. I had to figure out which settings felt best, when I got the most comfortable sessions and how to work pumping around everything else going on. I definitely didn’t get it right the first time.\n\nSome days my routine still gets completely thrown off.  That’s motherhood.\n\nBut I think that’s the biggest thing I’ve learned. Your routine doesn’t have to look perfect to be a good routine. Sometimes you just keep making little changes until you find something that works better for your life.\n\nFor me, the goal has never been to have the perfect pumping schedule. It’s been finding ways to make pumping feel a little more manageable while still being present for my babies.\n\nAnd honestly, anything that gives me a little more freedom during the day is a win in my book. \n\n#MyCozyFeedingSupport "}, {"cell_styles": {"font_size": 13, "vertical_alignment": "middle"}, "value": "FB 社群"}, {"cell_styles": {"font_size": 13, "vertical_alignment": "middle"}, {"font_size": 13}, "text": " Every Ounce Tells Our Story \nThe one thing that matters most to me about my Momcozy Wellness 1 is reliability because every ounce", "type": "text"}, {"style": {"font_color": "#f54a45", "font_size": 13, "font_weight": "bold"}, "text": " it collects represents time, dedication, and love. \n\n", "type": "text"}, {"style": {"font_size": 13}, "text": "For the past six months, this pump has been part of my daily routine. Through late-night sessions, busy days as an ER nurse, family trips, and the moments no one else sees, it has helped me continue providing breastmilk for my son.\n\nIf another mom asked me what to look for in a pump, I’d say this: choose one that fits your lifestyle and helps you stay consistent. Breastfeeding and pumping aren’t about perfection—they’re about showing up, one session at a time.\n\nEvery time I see these collection cups full of milk, I’m reminded that every pumping session, even the difficult ones, has been worth it. It’s more than milk—it’s love, patience, and six months of commitment for my baby. \n\n", "type": "text"}, {"link": "text": "#BeACozyMom", "type": "link"}], "value": " Every Ounce Tells Our Story \nThe one thing that matters most to me about my Momcozy Wellness 1 is reliability because every ounce it collects represents time, dedication, and love. \n\nFor the past six months, this pump has been part of my daily routine. Through late-night sessions, busy days as an ER nurse, family trips, and the moments no one else sees, it has helped me continue providing breastmilk for my son.\n\nIf another mom asked me what to look for in a pump, I’d say this: choose one that fits your lifestyle and helps you stay consistent. Breastfeeding and pumping aren’t about perfection—they’re about showing up, one session at a time.\n\nEvery time I see these collection cups full of milk, I’m reminded that every pumping session, even the difficult ones, has been worth it. It’s more than milk—it’s love, patience, and six months of commitment for my baby. \n\n#MyCozyFeedingSupport #Momcozy #BreastfeedingMonth #BeACozyMom"}, {"cell_styles": {"font_size": 13, {"font_size": 13}, "text": "Wellness 1 Breast Pump\nI’ve been using the Wellness 1 (W1) for a few weeks now and it’s turned into my favorite pump. I was previously using the M9, which I LOVE but when I saw the ", "type": "text"}, {"style": {"font_color": "#f54a45", "font_size": 13, "font_weight": "bold"}, "text": "warming and massage features of the W1", "type": "text"}, {"style": {"font_size": 13}, "text": " I had to try it. I’m a just enougher, and I’ve been very hard on myself this breastfeeding journey, so I figured, anything to help me continue to exclusively breastfeed my baby was worth it. I’ll admit, I had a bit of a learning curve with my W1, it was hard to figure out what settings work best for my body; but I think I’m finally getting the hang of it. I love how discreet it is. I can literally pump anywhere. ", "type": "text"}], "value": "Wellness 1 Breast Pump\nI’ve been using the Wellness 1 (W1) for a few weeks now and it’s turned into my favorite pump. I was previously using the M9, which I LOVE but when I saw the warming and massage features of the W1 I had to try it. I’m a just enougher, and I’ve been very hard on myself this breastfeeding journey, so I figured, anything to help me continue to exclusively breastfeed my baby was worth it. I’ll admit, I had a bit of a learning curve with my W1, it was hard to figure out what settings work best for my body; but I think I’m finally getting the hang of it. I love how discreet it is. I can literally pump anywhere. I use it in the car, at the grocery store and everyday at work; sometimes my coworkers forget I’m pumping until I tell them I have to pour lol.\nIt’s comfortable, light weight and pretty . There a few things I would change if I could, it doesn’t come with a case to carry it in like my M9 which was disappointing. I also found out the Air 1’s have a charging case which would be a game changer for the W1. Overall though, it’s a solid choice with 3 settings of warmth and massage which make pumping more comfortable and relaxing. {"cell_styles": {"font_size": 13, "vertical_alignment": "middle"}, "rich_text": [{"style": {"font_size": 13}, "text": "First Main Pump Advice\nBefore my baby was born, I spent hours researching breast pumps. Even though this is my third baby, it's my first time pumping while working, and I knew I wanted to breastfeed for at least a year. I got my primary pump through my insurance, and after reading countless reviews, I chose the BabyBuddha 2.0 because I wanted something hospital-grade that wasn't tethered to the wall.\n\nThe first time I used it, I realized it just wasn't the right fit for me. I didn't even know hands-free pumping bras existed, so I found myself holding the flanges the entire time. It made pumping feel like a chore, and I quickly realized that portability alone wasn't enough, I wanted true freedom while pumping.\n\nHere are the three things I wish I knew before buying my first pump:\n\nComfort matters just as much as suction. A powerful pump is great, but if it's uncomfortable or doesn't fit your lifestyle, you're much less likely to enjoy using it.\n\nThink about how you'll actually use your pump every day. I needed to be able to hold my baby, work, or do things around the house while pumping. Being hands-free became my top priority.\n\nDon't be afraid to switch if something isn't working. Just because a pump is highly recommended doesn't mean it's the best pump for you.\n\nAfter more research, I found the Momcozy M9, and I fell in love with it from the very first use. It gave me the freedom to hold my baby, move around, and pump without feeling tied down. It completely changed my pumping experience.\nWhat helped me avoid making another bad choice was joining the Momcozy Facebook community and using the Momcozy app. Reading real experiences from other moms taught me so much. That's actually how I discovered the W1. Since I'm a \"just enougher,\"", "type": "text"}, {"style": {"font_color": "#f54a45", "font_size": 13, "font_weight": "bold"}, "text": " the massage and warming features immediately caught my attention because they help encourage letdowns. ", "type": "text"}, {"style": {"font_size": 13}, "text": "It ended up becoming another favorite in my pumping routine.\n\nLooking back, the best advice I can give is to do your research, but also remember that the best pump is the one that fits your body, your lifestyle, and your breastfeeding goals.\n\n", "type": "text"}, {"link": "https://www.facebook.com/hashtag/firstmainpumpadvice?__cft__[0]=AZhTIIzLsCgTKSiLbY0yOMSGO4mGahxdT038uc8q3f2kra8LPSPc48ZKj6lcLPNRb0wqYpoDKIVT5B7mPR07_fQPF7_xzBe7bV0JrdTU7t217hr8OQMTeMcbownbJb29rkKMXimkPwL4GeXhzsVu&__tn__=*NK-R", "text": "#firstmainpumpadvice", "type": "link"}], "value": "First Main Pump Advice\nBefore my baby was born, I spent hours researching breast pumps. Even though this is my third baby, it's my first time pumping while working, and I knew I wanted to breastfeed for at least a year. I got my primary pump through my insurance, and after reading countless reviews, I chose the BabyBuddha 2.0 because I wanted something hospital-grade that wasn't tethered to the wall.\n\nThe first time I used it, I realized it just wasn't the right fit for me. I didn't even know hands-free pumping bras existed, so I found myself holding the flanges the entire time. It made pumping feel like a chore, and I quickly realized that portability alone wasn't enough, I wanted true freedom while pumping.\n\nHere are the three things I wish I knew before buying my first pump:\n\nComfort matters just as much as suction. A powerful pump is great, but if it's uncomfortable or doesn't fit your lifestyle, you're much less likely to enjoy using it.\n\nThink about how you'll actually use your pump every day. I needed to be able to hold my baby, work, or do things around the house while pumping. Being hands-free became my top priority.\n\nDon't be afraid to switch if something isn't working. Just because a pump is highly recommended doesn't mean it's the best pump for you.\n\nAfter more research, I found the Momcozy M9, and I fell in love with it from the very first use. It gave me the freedom to hold my baby, move around, and pump without feeling tied down. It completely changed my pumping experience.\nWhat helped me avoid making another bad choice was joining the Momcozy Facebook community and using the Momcozy app. Reading real experiences from other moms taught me so much. That's actually how I discovered the W1. Since I'm a \"just enougher,\" the massage and warming features immediately caught my attention because they help encourage letdowns. It ended up becoming another favorite in my pumping routine.\n\nLooking back, the best advice I can give is to do your research, but also remember that the best pump is the one that fits your body, your lifestyle, and your breastfeeding goals.\n\n#firstmainpumpadvice"}, {"cell_styles": {"font_size": 13, "vertical_alignment": "middle"}, "value": "FB 社群"}, {"cell_styles": {"font_size": 13,
